title: The replica symmetric solution for hypergraph independent sets in the critical regime
summary: We prove a variational formula for the logarithmic asymptotics of a non-existence probability in a broad class of combinatorial problems such as avoiding cliques in random graphs and $k$-term arithmetic progressions in random subsets of integers. These results follow from a formula for the probability that a binomial random subset of the vertices of a locally sparse hypergraph is an independent set.
